subject: Hosting decision checklist & next steps — SSO/KMS/logs
messages:
From: Maya Reddy <maya.reddy@helixbio.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Li <jordan.li@helixbio.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@helixbio.com>
Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up from call — SSO/KMS/log retention questions

Thanks for the walkthrough today, Karthik — helpful framing. A few items to confirm so our security & infra folks can finalize the hosting recommendation: 

1) SSO/Identity: we run Okta (SAML + OIDC). We need to ensure user-level audit events appear in our SIEM and we can disable provisioning for some service accounts. Can Redwood integrate with our Okta tenant and provide audit exports?

2) KMS/HSM: for PHI-derived models we need customer-controlled keys. Ideally a KMS integration with a customer-managed key (bring-your-own-key) or an HSM-backed flow. Can you describe key management patterns for both Hosted and Dedicated?

3) Logging retention / access: our compliance window is 7 years for certain audit logs, and logs must be immutable and exportable to our S3 with restricted access. What are typical retention options and export mechanisms?

4) Data residency: we prefer US-based compute and want to ensure log storage sits in our AWS account (if Dedicated/Private).

If you can send a short checklist mapping those requirements to the three hosting modes (Hosted API, Dedicated, Private VPC/on-prem) with recommended next steps, procurement will be able to accelerate. Also copying Procurement for any contract/po questions.

Best,
Maya
Director, Infrastructure & Security
HelixBio
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Reddy <maya.reddy@helixbio.com>
Cc: Jordan Li <jordan.li@helixbio.com>, dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Procurement Team <procurement@helixbio.com>
Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 17:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up from call — SSO/KMS/log retention questions

Thanks Maya — great questions. Per our call I pulled together a short mapping and proposed next steps; attaching the matrix and a simple hosting map. TL;DR recommendations up front: 

- Hosted API: fastest to prod, supports Okta SSO for user-level identity (OIDC), but does NOT currently support customer-managed KMS/HSM for model encryption. Logs are retained by Redwood and can be exported on request for shorter windows (90–365 days typical). Not recommended if Helix requires BYOK/HSM or 7-year immutable retention.

- Dedicated (reserved capacity): supports VPC peering or PrivateLink, can push logs to your S3 via secure delivery and supports longer retention configurations. KMS integration available for envelope encryption where you manage keys in your KMS (AWS KMS CMKs) — HSM-backed KMS via CloudHSM can be discussed. Suitable if you need key control and stronger isolation without full Private deployment.

- Private (VPC / on-prem): full control — customer-managed KMS/HSM, logs live in your account, long-term immutable retention possible, and all control-plane hooks go through your network. Higher setup time and likely an enterprise engagement. Recommended if policy requires customer-only key custody or certified air-gapped environments.

Next steps I propose: 
1) Tech deep-dive (60m) with our Solutions Engineer (Dev) + your infra team to validate KMS/HSM variants and the exact audit event set you need.
2) Share the SOC2 summary and short integration checklist (attached).
3) Procurement: if Dedicated looks appropriate, we'll send a preliminary SOW + pricing for reserved capacity options.

Dev — can you confirm the current KMS patterns we support in Dedicated and the gap list for Hosted (quick bullets)?

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Maya Reddy <maya.reddy@helixbio.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 08:01:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Follow-up from call — SSO/KMS/log retention questions

Hi team — quick technical notes to make the decision easier: 

1) SSO/Identity: Hosted supports OIDC with Okta (we already have customers onboarded). We emit authentication events (login, token issuance) into our audit stream. For Dedicated and Private we can optionally forward those events directly to your SIEM via our log forwarding (we support Syslog, Kinesis, and pushing to S3). We can also disable SCIM provisioning on a per-customer basis and use manual service account lifecycle.

2) KMS/HSM: 
  - Hosted: keys are managed by Redwood (we use a multi-tenant KMS) — no customer-managed keys today.
  - Dedicated: we offer envelope encryption where the data keys are wrapped by a CMK in the customer's AWS account (BYOK flow). For HSM-backed keys, we can integrate with customer CloudHSM clusters but that requires network peering and some additional NAT/route setup.
  - Private: full support for customer HSMs or on-prem HSM appliances since control plane sits in your network.

3) Logs & retention: 
  - We can configure long-term retention via pushing to your S3 (Dedicated/Private). For Hosted, we typically export 90–365d and can arrange longer retention via a billing/ops agreement, but audit immutability guarantees are limited compared to logs written into your account.

4) Compliance artifacts: attaching a short SOC2 summary and a checklist of items we'll need for the Private/Dedicated onboarding (network ranges, DNS, required IAM roles, KMS ARN examples).

Action items: 
- Maya: please confirm whether BYOK (AWS KMS CMK) is sufficient or if Helix requires HSM attestation (FIPS/PCI-style HSM).
- Jordan / Procurement: if Dedicated is preferred, we'll send a draft SOW and timeline (typical 6–8 weeks for provision + testing).
- Karthik: suggest we schedule the technical deep-dive Wed/Thu this week — I'll be available for either slot.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Li <jordan.li@helixbio.com>

Subject: Re: Follow-up from call — SSO/KMS/log retention questions

Appreciate the quick summary and the attachments. We discussed internally — BYOK via AWS KMS CMK should cover our needs for now, but we will want to validate HSM-backed key attestation later in the project.

Procurement is fine to receive a Dedicated SOW to evaluate costs/timelines. For the tech deep-dive, Wed 11 Nov 11:00 PT works for our team. Can you send a calendar invite and include a pre-read (network ranges, example IAM policy, and the audit event map)?

Jordan Li

HelixBio
